notes: The source page is the CNC Machine Operator, Associate in Science Degree page, not the Manufacturing Technology: Machinist Certificate of Achievement. The text contains no requirements section for the Machinist certificate; the REQUIREMENTS tab content is not included.

The only course listing is the A.S. degree's Program Sequence (plan of study grid, Total Units 60-62), which is an advisory map for a different award; no blocks were recorded from it. It also names MACH A125, MACH A126 and MACH A133, which are not in the closed list.

The Program Learning Outcomes printed on the page belong to the CNC Machine Operator A.S. degree page; they were not recorded for the Machinist certificate. A reviewer may decide whether they are shared. Note the last printed line merges an outcome with 'OUTCOME 5: Write advanced CAD/CAM programs for CNC LATHE and Milling Machines.'

The overview mentions that the CNC Machine Operator certificate builds on the Machinist certificate, but gives no Machinist requirements or total. A reviewer should locate the Machinist certificate page.
